content.statement: Cat in a box is in superposition |cat⟩ = (|alive⟩ + |dead⟩)/√2.

steps.title: Start from classical energy

steps.title: Promote observables to operators

codeExamples.code:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.quantum_info import Statevector
import json

LESSON_ID = '35-35-1-schr-dinger-s-cat'

steps.title: Define correlations
steps.text: Correlation is the average product of the two ±1 outcomes.

steps.title: Combine four settings
steps.text: CHSH combines four correlations into one test statistic.

steps.title: Compare bounds
steps.text: Quantum theory predicts values that can exceed the local bound.

codeExamples.code:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.quantum_info import Statevector
import json

LESSON_ID = '35-35-10-bell-test'
circuit = QuantumCircuit(2)
circuit.h(0)
circuit.cx(0, 1)
circuit.measure_all()
from qiskit.primitives import StatevectorSampler
sampler = StatevectorSampler(seed=7)
result = sampler.run([circuit], shots=1024).result()
print(json.dumps({'lesson': LESSON_ID, 'counts': result[0].data.meas.get_counts()}))
